label: Reptile / Amphibian
description: Cold-blooded subjects — scale texture, wet skin and thermoregulation moments.

items.name: tree-frog
items.text: a red-eyed tree frog splayed on a rain-beaded banana leaf, orange toe pads spread wide, scarlet eyes just unshuttering

items.name: chameleon
items.text: a panther chameleon mid-color-shift in bands of teal and fire, turret eyes swiveling in two directions, tail coiled like a fern tip

items.name: gecko
items.text: a gecko flattened on glass shot from below, toe pads spread into fanned ridges that grip by molecular force, pale belly scales tiled

items.name: sea-iguana
items.text: a marine iguana hauled out on black lava, sneezing a jet of brine from its salt glands, white crust crowning its spiked head

items.name: python-coil
items.text: a reticulated python stacked in symmetric coils, net-patterned skin flaring iridescent where the light rakes it, head at rest on the top loop

items.name: tortoise
items.text: a giant saddleback tortoise crossing cracked volcanic ground, shell flared high above its telescoping neck, one round leg planted at a time

items.name: axolotl
items.text: a pink leucistic axolotl hanging in clear water, three pairs of feathery crimson gills fanned wide, mouth set in its permanent half-smile

items.name: crocodile-eyes
items.text: a crocodile at ambush float, only eyes, brow ridges and nostril tips above the still water, armored scutes shadowed below the surface line

items.name: dart-frog
items.text: a cobalt poison dart frog no bigger than a thumbnail on wet moss, lacquer-bright skin advertising its alkaloids in unmissable blue

items.name: basilisk-sprint
items.text: a plumed basilisk sprinting upright across the water surface, fringed toes caging air at each strike, tail whipping for balance

items.name: komodo-dragon
items.text: a komodo dragon striding down a dry riverbed, long forked yellow tongue tasting the air, chainmail hide swinging with the rolling gait

items.name: frilled-lizard
items.text: a frilled lizard in full threat display, pleated neck frill snapped open like an umbrella, yellow gape wide, up on its hind legs

items.name: glass-frog
items.text: a glass frog clinging under a leaf, translucent belly skin revealing its tiny beating heart and coiled organs

items.name: sidewinder
items.text: a sidewinder rattlesnake crossing loose dune sand at speed, body lifted in two traveling arcs, leaving a ladder of disconnected J-shaped prints behind it

items.name: thorny-devil
items.text: a thorny devil standing still in a desert shower, capillary grooves between its spikes wicking water uphill across its skin to the corners of its mouth

items.name: fire-salamander
items.text: a fire salamander out on rain-soaked moss, lacquer-black skin blazed yellow in warning, the ridges behind its eyes dotted with toxin pores
